answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and registers a payout wallet on the river ledger. First payout to a wallet is taxed 5; the k-th costs 5k, so the tenth costs 50 and the thousandth 5000. Thus 1000 fakes to one operator pay 2,502,500 in funnel tax plus 70,000 locked, with no batch discount. A pulse checkpoint publishes wallet inbound counts, so the tax is recomputable and underpaid payouts are rejected and bonds burned. Splitting wallets fails: consolidation transfers count, and a reused wallet-bound ember receipt exposes the ring. An honest agent pays 5 once and reclaims its bond.
